_note: Stage X truth file. It holds ONLY the facts that have no other home.
The version, edition, subtitle, codename, display codename and signing
fingerprint used to live here too. Stage Q landed
tools/release/versions/<version>.toml as the per-release gate data, so
keeping a second copy here would have been the exact defect this stage
exists to remove. tools/drift_gate.py now reads that TOML as the
authority for all six.

urls._note: Also stated in the Makefile as PUBLIC_SITE / ARTIFACT_BASE.

_note: ADR-0009 specifies releases/CURRENT.json, written LAST by the release
publisher and read by the artifact worker, replacing latestRelease()'s
sort of an unpaginated 100-object R2 listing by upload time.
READER (done, Stage Y): the artifact worker reads this key, validates every
field, and refuses a pointer that names another signing key, names a retired
image, or is contradicted by the bucket. Only while NO pointer exists does it
fall back to a listing -- now paginated and ordered by semantic version
instead of upload time. The document's shape is
web/shadowfetch-linux-worker/tools/release_pointer.py, and r2_prune_release.py
refuses to prune a version the published pointer does not name.
and no releases/CURRENT.json exists in the bucket (checked 2026-09-09), so the
worker is still running on the fallback. Half a control is not a control.
WRITER (done): tools/publish_release_4_0_0.py builds the document with
web/shadowfetch-linux-worker/tools/release_pointer.py -- the same module the
reader validates against, so a writer cannot invent its own schema -- and
uploads it LAST, after the ISO's own bytes have been uploaded and streamed
back and compared. A pointer written earlier advertises, for the length of
an upload, an image the bucket does not hold. Its `published` field defaults
to the ISO's mtime so re-running the publisher rewrites nothing.
This status is now DERIVED by tools/drift_gate.py from what the reader and
the writer actually contain, and compared with the string above. It used to
be checked only against the literal 'NOT IMPLEMENTED', so the moment it
became anything else the gate could no longer see that it was stale.
